name: Bacteriophage T7 Proteome Gold Standard
description: Complete T7 proteome with functionally annotated ground truth for benchmarking viral protein annotation tools
source: UniProt proteome UP000000840 (Swiss-Prot reviewed) + NCBI RefSeq NC_001604.1 + literature
references: Dunn & Studier (1983) J Mol Biol 166:477-535 - Complete T7 genome sequence
Barr et al. (2013) PNAS 110:20189 - Gene 0.4 inhibits FtsZ
Qimron et al. (2006) Virology 348:413-421 - T7 gene functions
Hu et al. (2013) J Virol 88:1191 - T7 lysis genes
Cuervo et al. (2019) Nat Commun 10:3746 - T7 portal and tail structure
Molineux (2001) Mol Microbiol 40:669-674 - T7 ejection mechanism

entries.true_function: Anti-restriction protein Ocr - DNA mimic that inhibits EcoB/EcoK type I restriction enzymes
entries.notes: First gene expressed; overcomes host restriction defense; DNA mimic structure

entries.true_function: Host cell division inhibitor - inhibits FtsZ to block host cell division
entries.notes: Inhibits FtsZ; prevents daughter cell escape; competitive advantage

entries.true_function: Hypothetical protein - function unknown
entries.notes: Small nonessential early gene; function not characterized

entries.true_function: Protein 0.6B - function unknown, processed from same locus as 0.6A
entries.notes: Produced by programmed frameshift; 0.6A is the truncated form (53 aa)

entries.true_function: Protein 0.6A - function unknown, truncated form of 0.6B
entries.notes: Short form from same gene as 0.6B

entries.true_function: Serine/threonine protein kinase - phosphorylates host RNA polymerase to reduce early transcription
entries.notes: Phosphorylates host RNAP beta/beta' subunits; self-inactivating kinase

entries.true_function: T7 RNA polymerase - single-subunit RNAP that transcribes class II and III genes
entries.notes: Only essential class I gene; single-polypeptide RNAP; rifampicin-resistant; paradigm for molecular biology

entries.true_function: Uncharacterized protein 1.1 - function unknown
entries.notes: Transcribed by both host and T7 RNAP; function not characterized

entries.true_function: Inhibitor of host dGTPase - preserves dGTP pool for phage DNA synthesis
entries.notes: Inhibits host dGTP triphosphohydrolase; also target for F plasmid exclusion

entries.true_function: DNA ligase - joins Okazaki fragments during DNA replication
entries.notes: ATP-dependent DNA ligase; nonessential in wild-type E. coli (host ligase compensates)

entries.true_function: Hypothetical protein 1.4 - function unknown, small membrane protein
entries.notes: Small nonessential protein; predicted transmembrane domain

entries.true_function: Hypothetical protein 1.5 - function unknown
entries.notes: Smallest T7 protein (29 aa); function unknown

entries.true_function: Hypothetical protein 1.6 - function unknown
entries.notes: Small nonessential class II protein

entries.true_function: Nucleotide kinase - phosphorylates nucleotides for DNA synthesis
entries.notes: Confers sensitivity to dideoxythymidine; involved in nucleotide metabolism

entries.true_function: Hypothetical protein 1.8 - function unknown
entries.notes: Small nonessential class II protein

entries.true_function: Host RNA polymerase inhibitor - shuts down host transcription
entries.notes: Binds and inhibits E. coli RNA polymerase; enables full takeover by T7 RNAP

entries.true_function: Single-stranded DNA-binding protein (SSB) - binds ssDNA at replication fork and promotes strand annealing
entries.notes: Essential for T7 DNA replication; interacts with gp4 helicase and gp5 polymerase; also promotes recombination

entries.true_function: Endonuclease - putative endonuclease activity
entries.notes: NCBI annotates as endonuclease; function not fully characterized

entries.true_function: Endonuclease I - degrades host DNA; Holliday junction resolvase; recombination
entries.notes: Prefers ssDNA; works with gp6 exonuclease to degrade host chromosome for nucleotide recycling

entries.true_function: Endolysin (lysozyme) - N-acetylmuramidase that degrades peptidoglycan; also inhibits T7 RNA polymerase
entries.notes: Dual function: lysozyme for lysis AND feedback inhibitor of T7 RNAP class II transcription

entries.true_function: HNH endonuclease - putative homing endonuclease
entries.notes: Contains HNH endonuclease domain; NCBI annotates as HNH endonuclease

entries.true_function: DNA primase/helicase - full-length form with primase (N-terminal) and helicase (C-terminal) domains
entries.notes: 63 kDa full-length form; primase synthesizes RNA primers; helicase unwinds dsDNA; forms hexamer

entries.true_function: Hypothetical protein 4.1 - function unknown
entries.notes: Small protein internal to gene 4 region; overlaps with gene 4

entries.true_function: DNA helicase - truncated form lacking primase domain, helicase activity only
entries.notes: 56 kDa truncated form; internal translation initiation; helicase only; forms mixed hexamers with gp4A

entries.true_function: Hypothetical protein 4.2 - function unknown
entries.notes: Overlaps with gene 4 region

entries.true_function: Hypothetical protein 4.3 - function unknown
entries.notes: Small nonessential protein in gene 4 region

entries.true_function: Inhibitor of toxin-antitoxin system - neutralizes host TA defense
entries.notes: UniProt: inhibitor of toxin/antitoxin system; anti-host defense

entries.true_function: Protein 4.7 - function unknown
entries.notes: Class II gene; function not well characterized

entries.true_function: DNA-directed DNA polymerase - replicates T7 genome using host thioredoxin as processivity factor
entries.notes: Uses E. coli thioredoxin as sliding clamp; high-fidelity polymerase; widely used in sequencing (Sequenase)

entries.true_function: Hypothetical protein 5.3 - function unknown
entries.notes: Uncharacterized class II gene

entries.true_function: Fusion protein 5.5/5.7 - binds host H-NS nucleoid protein; lambda-rex exclusion; produced by -1 frameshift
entries.notes: Frameshift fusion of 5.5 and 5.7; neutralizes H-NS; permits growth on lambda lysogens

entries.true_function: Protein suppressor of silencing - binds host H-NS nucleoid protein to suppress host gene silencing
entries.notes: Permits growth on lambda lysogens; forms ternary complex with H-NS and tRNA

entries.true_function: Protein 5.7 - involved in lambda-rex exclusion
entries.notes: Conserved; non-essential; C-terminal portion of 5.5-5.7 fusion

entries.true_function: RecBCD nuclease inhibitor - protects T7 DNA from host RecBCD exonuclease degradation
entries.notes: Inhibits host RecBCD; protects linear T7 DNA ends from exonuclease degradation

entries.true_function: Exonuclease - 5'-to-3' exonuclease that degrades host DNA and removes RNA primers from Okazaki fragments
entries.notes: Works with gp3 endonuclease to recycle host DNA nucleotides; also processes Okazaki fragments with gp1.3 ligase

entries.true_function: Hypothetical protein 6.3 - function unknown; contains DUF5516 domain
entries.notes: Last class II gene; smallest characterized ORF; DUF5516 domain

entries.true_function: Protein 6.5 - function unknown; contains DUF2717 domain
entries.notes: First class III gene; function not characterized

entries.true_function: Protein 6.7 - ejected with internal core during infection; contains DUF5476 domain
entries.notes: Internal capsid component ejected during DNA delivery; absent after DNA ejection in cryo-EM

entries.true_function: Host range and adsorption protein - involved in tail structure and host range determination
entries.notes: Determines host range specificity; part of tail-associated structure

entries.true_function: Host range protein - internal capsid component; possible channel plug ejected during infection
entries.notes: Internal head protein; ejected during DNA delivery; may act as plug for tail channel

entries.true_function: HNH endonuclease - putative homing endonuclease
entries.notes: Contains HNH endonuclease domain; NCBI annotates as HNH endonuclease

entries.true_function: Portal protein (head-tail connector) - dodecameric ring connecting head to tail; DNA translocation channel
entries.notes: 12-fold symmetry ring; DNA packaging channel; interfaces with internal core and tail

entries.true_function: Capsid assembly scaffolding protein - guides procapsid assembly then removed during maturation
entries.notes: Required for proper procapsid assembly; degraded/removed during capsid maturation

entries.true_function: Minor capsid protein - produced by translational frameshift; 10% of capsid protein pool
entries.notes: Gp10A + 53 aa C-terminal extension from frameshifting; used in T7 phage display

entries.true_function: Major capsid protein - 420 copies form icosahedral shell; 90% of capsid protein pool
entries.notes: Primary structural component of the icosahedral head; 38 kDa; HK97-fold

entries.true_function: Tail tubular protein (adaptor) - 12-fold ring connecting portal to nozzle
entries.notes: Tail adaptor protein; 12-fold ring; bridges portal (gp8) to nozzle (gp12)

entries.true_function: Tail tubular protein (nozzle) - 6-fold ring at tail tip; receptor interaction during infection
entries.notes: Tail nozzle protein; 6-fold ring; opens during DNA ejection; contacts host membrane

entries.true_function: Internal virion protein - scaffold/plug protein required for host binding and infection initiation
entries.notes: Internal head protein; required for irreversible cell binding; ejected during DNA delivery; possible channel plug

entries.true_function: Internal virion protein (ejection protein) - forms outer membrane pore for genome translocation
entries.notes: 12 copies in internal core; ejected and forms outer membrane pore; 20.8 kDa

entries.true_function: Internal virion protein (ejection protein) - forms periplasmic portion of ejectosome channel
entries.notes: 8 copies in internal core; ejected to form ejectosome channel through periplasm; 84.2 kDa

entries.true_function: Internal virion protein (ejection protein) with peptidoglycan transglycosylase - forms inner membrane portion of ejectosome; degrades cell wall during entry
entries.notes: Largest T7 protein (144 kDa); 4 copies in core; lytic transglycosylase domain for peptidoglycan degradation during entry; bridges to inner membrane

entries.true_function: Tail fiber protein - homotrimeric fibers for LPS receptor recognition and host attachment
entries.notes: 6 trimeric fibers; recognizes E. coli LPS; C-terminal receptor-binding domain; first reversible attachment step

entries.true_function: Holin (type II) - forms channels in inner membrane to allow endolysin access to peptidoglycan
entries.notes: Type II holin; deletion delays but does not prevent lysis; other T7 genes may have backup holin activity

entries.true_function: Terminase small subunit - recognizes concatemer junction; guides large subunit for DNA packaging
entries.notes: Small terminase; recognizes right end of concatemer; works with gp19 for DNA packaging

entries.true_function: Spanin inner membrane subunit (Rz analog) - inner membrane component of spanin complex for outer membrane disruption during lysis
entries.notes: Rz-like spanin; inner membrane component; interacts with gp18.7 (Rz1-like); needed for lysis at high salt

entries.true_function: Spanin outer membrane subunit (Rz1 analog) - outer membrane lipoprotein component of spanin complex
entries.notes: Rz1-like spanin; outer membrane lipoprotein; overlapping gene with 18.5; fuses inner and outer membranes

entries.true_function: Terminase large subunit - ATPase motor that translocates DNA into prohead during packaging
entries.notes: Large terminase; DNA-dependent ATPase; translocates unit-length genome into prohead; cuts concatemer

entries.true_function: Hypothetical protein 19.2 - function unknown
entries.notes: Overlaps with gene 19; conserved among T7-like phages; function unknown

entries.true_function: Hypothetical protein 19.3 - function unknown
entries.notes: Small late gene; conserved among T7-like phages

entries.true_function: Protein 19.5 - potential lysis-related function; upregulated when holin is deleted
entries.notes: Potential backup lysis function; mutations accumulate in T7-delta-holin evolution experiments

gene_classes.I: Early genes (0.3-1) - transcribed by host RNAP; host takeover
gene_classes.I/II: Transition genes (1.1-1.3) - transcribed by both host and T7 RNAP
gene_classes.II: Middle genes (1.4-6.3) - transcribed by T7 RNAP; DNA metabolism
gene_classes.III: Late genes (6.5-19.5) - transcribed by T7 RNAP; structural/packaging/lysis

challenge_proteins: gp0.4 (51 aa) - very small; host_interaction via FtsZ inhibition
gp2 (64 aa) - very small; host RNAP inhibitor
gp5.9 (52 aa) - very small; RecBCD inhibitor
gp1.5 (29 aa) - smallest T7 protein; unknown function
gp16 (1318 aa) - largest T7 protein; dual function structural+enzymatic
gp3.5 (151 aa) - dual function: lysozyme AND T7 RNAP inhibitor
gp0.3 (117 aa) - DNA mimic; host_interaction not obvious from sequence
dual_function_proteins: gp3.5: lysis (lysozyme) + regulatory (T7 RNAP inhibitor) - classified as lysis
gp16: structural (ejection protein) + enzymatic (transglycosylase) - classified as structural
gp0.7: regulatory (kinase) + host_interaction (inactivates host RNAP) - classified as regulatory
expected_difficulties: 14 unknown/hypothetical proteins challenge any annotation tool
Many host_interaction proteins are small (<100 aa) and may lack structural homologs
T7 is a well-studied model phage - most proteins should be in databases
Gene 4A/4B and 10A/10B are alternative products from same gene (frameshift/internal initiation)
Gene 5.5/5.7 fusion product from programmed frameshift
